feedback: Your essay presents a clear stance on cellphone usage, which is a good start. However, you must be careful with your sentence construction and the logical flow of your ideas. In your second paragraph, you mention cyberbullying but then label it as 'useful,' which contradicts your point and confuses the reader. Focusing on these structural and logical links will make your argument much more persuasive.
